verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a REST API and a published OpenAPI 3.1 spec, but no official client SDK in any language. A raw REST API or spec is only a building block for generating clients, and the only CLI/MCP tooling mentioned is an unofficial community project, so neither earns credit. Official SDKs are a fair axis for a cloud GPU platform, so absence of evidence yields "none".

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
